summary: Repository set up from the project brief: knowledge base, data files and dashboard created.
Dashboard redesigned to be easier to follow: this week's jobs up front, plain-English reasons for each job, must-have checklists, and jargon explained on tap.
Added Sky Barrage, a SmartMotion arcade game with 20 levels, in a new Games section of the dashboard.
Added the Print & Design workspace: a 3D model library with 3D views, downloads (STL + STEP), print settings and lessons. Three starter models for the rig: button box, cable clip and VR headset hook.
Dashboard rebuilt as a website for Cloudflare Pages: app icon and phone home-screen support, normal file downloads, and a build that checks the data before every deploy.
Version 1.1.0: the dashboard now shows whether you're signed in (and warns in red if the website has no login protection), and shows its version number under the logo.

Version 1.2.0: new game SmartMotion Flight, a flight simulator-style game around Duxford with SmartMotion signs, a trainer and a WW2 fighter, a gate race, phone, laptop and Meta Quest (VR) support, and motion telemetry for the simulator rig.

Version 1.3.0: SmartMotion Flight now also exists as a native Windows game (built with the Godot engine) that uses the PC's graphics card, with Meta Quest 3 VR over Link and a direct UDP link to the motion rig. It is built automatically and published as a download.

Version 1.4.0: Sam flew the native game in VR on the Quest 3 for the first time; it worked but was hard to control. Flying is now easier (Easy mode sets full power on the runway, power keys respond three times faster, WASD flies in VR too, the right trigger adds power on the Quest controller) and the graphics are better (puffy clouds, a richer sky, proper trees across the countryside, more ground detail, softer light and shadows).
